selected_records.title: ESP: Energy-Score Policy for One-Step Multimodal Action Generation

article.body:
ESP paper gives no production or deployment details

An arXiv record lists “ESP: Energy-Score Policy for One-Step Multimodal Action Generation.” The supplied information establishes no factory, production process, equipment installation or deployment. It specifies no output capacity, physical constraint, or customer or supplier dependency. The record therefore provides no basis to assess whether the work has moved beyond a research paper into industrial production.
